{{Top|leg}}
'''Spaaga Core, Inc.''' was a company specializing in the production of industrial-grade gems for use in [[Laser/Legends|laser]] technology. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Spaage acquired the mining rights to a planet in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] and announced they were entering the [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas market. However, [[Nal Hutta Kal'tamok/Legends|''Nal Hutta Kal'tamok'']] reported that sources revealed the planet actually produced [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]].
